keep: road curb and planter/terrace edge system
mapped stairs and landings directly serving the crooked block
mapped handrails and footways directly serving the crooked block
retaining conditions tied to road or stair system
hedges/planting masses that define immediate terraces
shallow terrain shell needed to support visible core geometry
temporarily_exclude: broad Hyde street context beyond minimal tie-in
broad Leavenworth street context beyond minimal tie-in
outer terrain shelves not supporting the core

geometry_policy.terrain_rule: Retain terrain only within the core corridor and around included hardscape, with a small support margin.
geometry_policy.building_rule: No building shells in the active core review artifact.
geometry_policy.reintroduction_rule: Outer context returns only after the core corridor passes flyaround review.
